request.style: English, storytelling folk, friendly baritone male vocal, acoustic guitar, banjo, fiddle, upright bass, foot-stomp percussion, warm and lively, 100 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The day was long on the grassy hill, the sun was sinking low
Five thousand hungry people and nowhere else to go
Send them to the villages, the twelve said, let them go and buy their bread
You give them something to eat, the Master simply said

[Verse]
Andrew found a little boy with a basket at his side
Five barley loaves and two small fish was all he could provide
But what is that among so many? Andrew asked aloud
Bring them here to me, said Jesus, and he looked out on the crowd

[Chorus]
Five loaves and two fish
In the Master's hands
He looked up to heaven, gave thanks and broke the bread
And every one was fed
They all ate and were satisfied
Twelve baskets left besides

[Verse]
Have the people sit, he said, there was plenty of green grass
He broke the bread and gave it out to every hand to pass
From hand to hand it did not end, and no one could say how
Gather up the leftover pieces, so that nothing is wasted now

[Bridge]
What is that among so many?
Bring them here to me
Little in a boy's two hands
Was plenty there for all to see

[Chorus]
Five loaves and two fish
In the Master's hands
He looked up to heaven, gave thanks and broke the bread
And every one was fed
They all ate and were satisfied
Twelve baskets left besides

[Outro]
Five loaves and two fish
In the Master's hands
